# This test only checks that basic network lookups work.
# The full test of toolchain version selection is in gotoolchain.txt.

# This test is sensitive to "new" Go experiments, so
# update the environment to remove any existing GKEXPERIMENT
# setting, see #62016 for more on this. 
env GKEXPERIMENT=''

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.21actual

# GKTOOLCHAIN from network, does not exist
env GKTOOLCHAIN=go1.9999x
! go version
stderr 'gecko: download go1.9999x for .*: toolchain not available'

# GKTOOLCHAIN from network
[!exec:/bin/sh] stop 'the fake proxy serves shell scripts instead of binaries'
env GKTOOLCHAIN=go1.999testmod
go version
stderr 'gecko: downloading go1.999testmod \(.*/.*\)'

# GKTOOLCHAIN cached from network
go version
! stderr downloading
stdout go1.999testmod

# GKTOOLCHAIN with GKSUMDB enabled but at a bad URL should operate in cache and not try badurl
env oldsumdb=$GKSUMDB
env GKSUMDB=$oldsumdb' http://badurl'
go version
! stderr downloading
stdout go1.999testmod

# GKTOOLCHAIN with GOSUMB=off should fail, because it cannot access even the cached sumdb info
# without the sumdb name.
env GKSUMDB=off
! go version
stderr '^gecko: golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.999testmod.[a-z0-9\-]*: verifying module: checksum database disabled by GKSUMDB=off$'

# GKTOOLCHAIN with GKSUMDB enabled but at a bad URL should fail if cache is incomplete
env GKSUMDB=$oldsumdb' http://badurl'
rm $GKPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb
! go version
! stderr downloading
stderr 'panic: use of network' # test catches network access
env GKSUMDB=$oldsumdb
